name: Lionstone Styles
intro: Pick one style per group and combine the codes, for example O4 W3 A3 G5 S4 P3. Every style is a recipe of real Lionstone options, so `lionstone styles --cmd O4 W3 A3` prints the exact edit command.

groups.name: Opening
groups.blurb: The first seconds: how the title enters.

styles.name: Quiet Fade
styles.desc: Title fades in and out with a slow, calm ease. Safe for interviews and lectures.

styles.name: Slow Rise
styles.desc: Title drifts upward while it fades in. Documentary feel.

styles.name: Hairline Reveal
styles.desc: A thin line draws out, then the title appears under it. Clean and corporate.

styles.name: Light Sweep
styles.desc: A band of light glides across the letters as they appear. Premium and cinematic.

styles.name: Film Grain Open
styles.desc: Title sits in animated film grain with a soft vignette. Story-driven pieces.

styles.name: Kinetic Hook
styles.desc: Words land one after another with a stagger. Built for Shorts and Reels hooks.

styles.name: Signature Stamp
styles.desc: Your brand name reveals with a short, confident flourish. Channel intros.

groups.name: Words
groups.blurb: How speech shows up on screen.

styles.name: Clean Lines
styles.desc: Readable burned-in captions, sentence case, bottom third.

styles.name: Bold Punch
styles.desc: Large, heavy captions that carry the energy of the delivery.

styles.name: Word Highlight
styles.desc: Social-style captions with the spoken word highlighted as it is said.

styles.name: Silent Frame
styles.desc: No captions on the picture. Calm, premium, or when the footage already has text.

styles.name: Sidecar Only
styles.desc: Captions exported as .srt/.vtt files, nothing burned in. For YouTube and podcasts.

groups.name: Aspect
groups.blurb: Shape of the frame and how it follows the speaker.

styles.name: Native
styles.desc: Keep the source shape untouched.

styles.name: Wide Stage
styles.desc: 16:9 for YouTube and presentations.

styles.name: Vertical Follow
styles.desc: 9:16 with a face-following crop. Needs OpenCV (pip install lionstone[vision]).

styles.name: Vertical Centre
styles.desc: 9:16 with a fixed centre crop. No extra dependencies.

styles.name: Square Follow
styles.desc: 1:1 with a face-following crop for feeds. Needs OpenCV.

styles.name: Portrait Feed
styles.desc: 4:5 centre crop, the tallest shape most feeds show uncropped.

groups.name: Grade
groups.blurb: The colour look applied after exposure correction.

styles.name: Untouched
styles.desc: No colour work at all.

styles.name: Natural
styles.desc: Light contrast and saturation lift. The default, safe everywhere.

styles.name: Warm Room
styles.desc: Gently warmer shadows and skin. Friendly, conversational.

styles.name: Cool Studio
styles.desc: Cooler balance for tech, science and corporate topics.

styles.name: Punchy
styles.desc: More contrast, saturation and local sharpness. Reads well on phones.

styles.name: Film
styles.desc: Softer saturation with a medium-contrast curve. Cinematic.

styles.name: YouTube -14
styles.desc: -14 LUFS with a -1 dB true-peak ceiling, light de-noise.

styles.name: Podcast -16
styles.desc: -16 LUFS for Apple and Spotify spoken word, light de-noise.

styles.name: Broadcast -23
styles.desc: EBU R128 at -23 LUFS for TV and festivals.

styles.name: Social -14 Tight
styles.desc: -14 LUFS with a narrower loudness range so it survives phone speakers.

styles.name: Rescue
styles.desc: YouTube loudness with strong de-noise for noisy rooms.

groups.name: Pace
groups.blurb: How aggressively silences and fillers are cut.

styles.name: Breathing Room
styles.desc: Keeps natural pauses and filler words, removes only long dead air and exact repeats.

styles.name: Tidy
styles.desc: Removes fillers, repeats and false starts but keeps sentence beats.

styles.name: Tight
styles.desc: Shortest pauses and discourse markers removed. Fast, social pacing.

groups.name: Labels
groups.blurb: Chapter cards and speaker lower thirds.

styles.name: Editorial Labels
styles.desc: Chapter cards and an editorial lower third for each new speaker.

styles.name: Spaced Chapters
styles.desc: Wide-tracked chapter titles with the editorial lower third.

styles.name: Line Chapters
styles.desc: Hairline chapter reveals, same lower third. Minimal and corporate.

presets.name: Podcast clip
presets.why: Calm, readable, loudness for audio apps.

presets.name: Talking-head Reel
presets.why: Fast hook, highlighted words, phone-friendly sound.

presets.name: Cinematic talk
presets.why: Slow, premium, no captions on the picture.
